docs.text: 10,000th follower gets a free "LAKE SUPERIOR GOT ME WET" bumper sticker.
I made this fun little map the other day. I liked it so much that I made one for all the towns on Minnesota's North Shore, and I made them available as stickers. www.redbubble.com/people/brhph...
gah i made some great lakes decal sales, and just so everyone knows i don't make a ton of money from redbubble, but i'm so happy to have stuff that makes people happy
heyyyyy fyi i made some great lakes decals that should be all up in my redbubble shop! www.redbubble.com/shop/ap/1661...

for my fellow Little Stamps Freaks you can download the Lake Superior Circle passport here (with addresses for the local tourism offices that will stamp your passport in each town) lakesuperiorcircletour.info/downloads/
I love this sticker almost as much as the song… (I grew up surrounded by the Great Lakes in Michigan)
might have some great lakes merch going up in my redbubble shop soon 👀

I live near the Great Lakes Naval Base, so on my daily commute, I see a lot of government vehicles out of state plates, etc... Today, though, I saw someone with a Virginia plate, that had a vanity frame that read: COLD WAR VETERAN I'm sorry, what?
Someone bought a lake erie sticker from my redbubble Thank you ❤️

Perfection. Nice sticker too! My friend has a shirt with a Stealie with the State of Michigan Outline with the Great Lakes and it says Grateful Lakes. Your sticker reminds me of that. I really dig it.

Also can’t quite tell what the lettering says over Ohio from other angles, or where it ends, but based on a Kentucky outline but know Minnesota outline, I am calling it an Ohio tattoo with Great Lakes elements.
Haha I have the same Lake Superior sticker, it’s on my cooler.
I laughed so hard when I found it. It'll go next to the Lake Superior Got Me Wet sticker.

Never at all been a car sticker guy, but when I saw this (very detailed) 4" sticker of the Great Lakes watershed, I kind of needed it on my car. I've seen stickers with the land map of Michigan alone. Those are alright. But this pure "water-map" is something else.

Did you ever see the series of US stamps of regions of the US, with their birds, wildlife, etc in them? They were very nice & I hated using the stamps but such nice explanations on the back of the sheet. I bought several of the Great Lakes sheet. (People will likely enjoy your labeled photos.) :)
I have the same unsalted Great Lakes sticker as a magnet on my fridge
This is such a Mexican-American male coded truck. Just replace that great lakes sticker with a NL sticker and that truck is right at home in a Houston Home Depot parking lot.

Official eclipse/nautical compass of my Bayfront designs. Different versions will be used on T-Shirts, posters, etc. The U shaped object at the top is based on ancient Native American fish hooks found around the Great Lakes regions.
You're right. It could be interpreted that way! It's a Michigan sticker though, so it's probably one of the Great Lakes.
Looks like based off of the plate it's an Iraq War veteran. One of the stickers looks like it's the Great Lakes. Not sure what the feather with the sword handle or cross is
Central coast of the USA (Great Lakes area) Love the idea of the stickers to cover some unsightliness of a certain name on the cover.
